role: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
recipient_role: Careers inbox (named on the careers page for expressions of interest)
subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil design, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites graduate civil engineers and draftspersons to email an introduction and CV, so I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil design work in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

Your estate work on drainage, retarding basins and roads is the kind of land development design I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study, not a paid role, so mentoring is what I am looking for.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate or design support role, or have a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil engineer or civil design
paragraphs: I am writing to express interest in graduate civil engineering or civil design work with Breese Pitt Dixon. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised role; your careers page invites graduate civil engineers and draftspersons to send an introduction and CV.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Your more than forty years of Melbourne estate work, from drainage and retarding basins to roads, is the land development design I want to grow into. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My drafting experience is from study rather than a paid role, so I would value mentoring from your team.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.

notes: SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY. Victoria off-SEEK rotation. Breese Pitt Dixon careers page read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT says the firm does not advertise individual vacancies and asks for expressions of interest with a CV at info@bpd.com.au. Labelled clearly as speculative in subject and body. Gaps: no Australian consulting employment yet, drafting from study, no sewer or water project work.
